option_relations.rationale: Developmental delay is a symptom or finding, not a specific disease diagnosis, and is not directly related to Klippel-Trenaunay-Weber Syndrome.
RASA1-related disorders (Capillary Malformation-Arteriovenous Malformation Syndrome) is a distinct genetic disorder involving vascular malformations, but it is not Klippel-Trenaunay-Weber Syndrome.
Vascular malformation of the nose is a specific finding or localized condition, not a comprehensive systemic diagnosis like Klippel-Trenaunay-Weber Syndrome.
Concurrent Microcephaly-capillary malformation syndrome (MIC-CAP) and Mowat-Wilson syndrome (MWS) are distinct genetic syndromes and are not related to Klippel-Trenaunay-Weber Syndrome.
